name: career-quest
description: A comprehensive career exploration and personality assessment application

scripts.build:android: npm run build && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.build:ios: npm run build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:release: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:install: npm run android:build:debug && cd android && ./gradlew installDebug
scripts.release:build: npm run release:prepare && npm run android:build:release
scripts.beta:android: npm run beta:prepare && npm run android:build:release
scripts.beta:ios: npm run beta:prepare && npx cap open ios

author: Career Quest Team
